how_derived: The hand case is computed on paper. The 'declared' block is what the pack promises about the rule. The 'pinned' block is a MEASUREMENT on the development seed (20260930, measured 30 Sep 2026), kept as a regression pin: it is not derived by hand and it is not a claim about any other seed.

hand_case.why: baseline: 50 trades at +100000 and 50 at -100000: mean 0, sample variance 100 x 100000^2 / 99 = 1000000000000/99. Allowed squared deviation = 4^2 x variance x (1/50 + 1/100) = 16 x 1000000000000/99 x 3/100 = 160000000000/33 = 4848484848.48... A window of 50 trades at 69631 has squared deviation 69631^2 = 4848476161 (inside); at -69632 it is 69632^2 = 4848615424 (outside; the rule is two-sided). A baseline of 49 trades does not arm the detector.

declared_why: K = 150 settled trades after the change (three windows of 50). On seeded synthetic sequences: at most 2% of stationary runs are paused, at least 85% of runs with a change are paused within K. On the development corpus: the regime world is paused after the known instant and within K, before any halt; the stationary world is not paused.
